description: This file contains implementation of engine ignition advance mapping, including functions for calculating ignition timing based on RPM, load, temperature corrections, and build default timing maps. It defines static variables, external references, and functions related to ignition advance calculations and corrections for a fuel injection system.

methods.name: isStep1Condition
methods.description: Checks if the engine RPM meets the condition for step 1 limiter.

methods.name: getRunningAdvance
methods.description: Calculates ignition advance angle before TDC during engine running conditions based on RPM and load.

methods.name: getAdvanceCorrections
methods.description: Calculates total ignition timing correction based on intake air temperature and other factors.

methods.name: getCrankingAdvance
methods.description: Calculates ignition advance angle during engine cranking based on RPM and load.

methods.name: getAdvance
methods.description: Determines overall ignition advance angle considering cranking or running conditions.

methods.name: setDefaultIatTimingCorrection
methods.description: Initializes default ignition timing correction table based on engine load and RPM bins.

methods.name: initTimingMap
methods.description: Initializes ignition timing maps in RAM with default or configured values.

methods.name: getTopAdvanceForBore
methods.description: Calculates maximum ignition advance based on engine bore, octane, compression, and style.

methods.name: getAdvanceForRpm
methods.description: Provides ignition advance based on RPM, with maximum limit.

methods.name: getInitialAdvance
methods.description: Calculates initial ignition advance based on RPM, load, and maximum advance.

methods.name: buildTimingMap
methods.description: Builds a default timing map based on heuristics for MAP-based engine load.
